shortDescription: A wrapper to the unix getent utility

options.name: database
options.description: The name of a getent database supported by the target system (passwd, group, hosts, etc).

options.name: fail_key
options.description: If a supplied key is missing this will make the task fail if V(true).

options.name: key
options.description: Key from which to return values from the specified database, otherwise the full contents are returned.

options.name: service
options.description: Override all databases with the specified service The underlying system must support the service flag which is not always available.

options.name: split
options.description: Character used to split the database values into lists/arrays such as V(:) or V(\\t), otherwise it will try to pick one depending on the database.
